question: ports inside France, geojson point + lon/lat 4dp
sql: SELECT p.name, ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS geojson, ROUND(ST_X(p.geometry), 4) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(p.geometry), 4) AS lat FROM ports p JOIN countries c ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE c.name = 'France' ORDER BY p.name, lon, lat

question: South Korea and Japan ports; country, port, WKT, lon/lat 5dp
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, p.name AS port, ST_AsText(p.geometry) AS wkt, ROUND(ST_X(p.geometry), 5) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(p.geometry), 5) AS lat FROM ports p JOIN countries c ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE c.name IN ('South Korea', 'Japan') ORDER BY c.name, p.name

question: ports within 500 km of Molde (7.1574,62.7364); name, distance_km 1dp, geojson
sql: WITH molde AS (SELECT ST_Point(7.1574, 62.7364) AS geom) SELECT p.name, ROUND(ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, m.geom)/1000.0, 1) AS distance_km, ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS geojson FROM ports p, molde m WHERE ST_Distance_Spheroid(p.geometry, m.geom) <= 500000 ORDER BY distance_km, p.name

question: France polygon geojson + area sq km 0dp
sql: SELECT name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson, ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)/1000000.0, 0) AS area_sq_km FROM countries WHERE name = 'France'

question: Asia countries GDP > 1e6; name, gdp_bn 2dp, centroid lon/lat 3dp
sql: SELECT name, ROUND(gdp_md/1000.0, 2) AS gdp_bn, ROUND(ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)), 3) AS centroid_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)), 3) AS centroid_lat FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Asia' AND gdp_md > 1000000 ORDER BY gdp_md DESC, name

question: Guatemala ports; name, website, lon/lat formatted 'lon,lat' 4dp
sql: SELECT p.name, p.website, printf('%.4f,%.4f', ST_X(p.geometry), ST_Y(p.geometry)) AS lonlat FROM ports p JOIN countries c ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE c.name = 'Guatemala' ORDER BY p.name
